reasons.ArrayToSorted: False positive in @radix-ui/react-collection 1.1.7: OrderedDict defines its own toSorted method using [...this.entries()].sort(compareFn). Its callers operate on OrderedDict, not Array.prototype.toSorted. Recheck this exception when upgrading Radix.
reasons.Uint8ArrayFromHex: Guarded optional fast path in @noble/hashes 2.4.0 utils.js: hasHexBuiltin checks both native hex methods before hexToBytes calls Uint8Array.fromHex, with an ASCII parsing fallback otherwise. Visible in non-tree-shaken builds. Recheck when upgrading @noble/hashes.
reasons.Uint8ArrayToHex: Guarded optional fast path in @noble/hashes 2.4.0 utils.js: hasHexBuiltin checks both native hex methods before bytesToHex calls bytes.toHex, with a lookup-table fallback otherwise. Visible in non-tree-shaken builds. Recheck when upgrading @noble/hashes.
